title: K200 Powder Coated Road Train Custom Bullbar #8
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile fully powder coated aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar 381 style channel cow catcher and 5 mini uprights. Standard 100mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection 100mm box uprights shown. Cow catcher and five (5) small uprights. Reversible aluminium Road Train/Long Vehicle signs with powder coated covers. Dual assist lift springs. Provision for front mudflaps. Driving light mounts to outer top pipe. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
